Data.subject: Population and Population Structure
Data.title: Singapore Residents By Age Group And Type Of Dwelling, Annual
Data.footnote: Residents comprise Singapore citizens and permanent residents. Data from 2003 onwards exclude residents who are overseas for a continuous period of 12 months or longer as at the reference period. More information available on the following: Population Trends report (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/population-trends-2026); Information Paper on 'Singapore Resident Population, 2003-2007' (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/singapore-resident-population-2003-2007); How Singapore's Population Estimates Are Compiled (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/understanding-singapore-population-estimates)
